title: Too Emotional to Be Fake? Intra-Utterance Emotion Shifts Expose Failure Modes in Speech Deepfake Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2610.22832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expressive speech synthesis can now change emotion within a single utterance, yet its impact on deepfake detection remains unclear. We introduce EmoShift, a benchmark comparing emotion-stable (AA) and emotion-changing (AB) speech to examine these effects while accounting for static emotion identity and acoustic confounds. It comprises 7,240 bona fide utterances from four source datasets and 9,720 synthetic utterances generated using four expressive TTS systems. Across seven detectors, we find that emotion changes can make synthetic speech appear more genuine, increasing spoof miss rates by up to 25.3 percentage points on OMG-Emotion at fixed thresholds. Conversely, emotion-changing bona fide speech increases false-alarm rates by up to 24.4 percentage points on IEMOCAP. translated_title: 太情绪化反而不像伪造？语句内情绪变化暴露语音深度伪造检测器的失效模式
translated_abstract: 表现性语音合成技术现已能在单个语句内改变情绪，但其对深度伪造检测的影响仍不明确。我们提出EmoShift基准，通过对比情绪稳定（AA）与情绪变化（AB）的语音来检验这些影响，同时控制静态情绪身份和声学混淆因素。该基准包含来自四个源数据集的7,240条真实语音，以及使用四个表现性TTS系统生成的9,720条合成语音。在七个检测器上的实验表明：情绪变化会使合成语音显得更加真实，在固定阈值下，OMG-Emotion数据集上的伪造漏检率最高增加25.3个百分点；相反，情绪变化的真实语音会使IEMOCAP数据集上的误报率最高增加24.4个百分点。进一步分析揭示了各检测器对情绪轨迹的特异性敏感，这无法完全由静态情绪身份或拼接伪影所解释。这些发现凸显了当前语音深度伪造检测系统在情绪表达维度的关键脆弱性。
tldr: 提出EmoShift基准，揭示语句内情绪变化会显著降低语音深度伪造检测的可靠性——情绪变化的合成语音漏检率最高上升25.3个百分点，而情绪变化的真实语音误报率最高上升24.4个百分点。
en_tdlr: The EmoShift benchmark reveals that intra-utterance emotion shifts expose critical failure modes in speech deepfake detectors, with emotion-changing synthetic speech increasing miss rates by up to 25.3 percentage points and emotion-changing bona fide speech raising false-alarm rates by up to 24.4 percentage points.
